chunks: Evil is the case of those who deny Our signs and wrong themselves.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people that wronged themselves by denying God's signs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf underscores the concept of 'zulm al-nafs' (injustice to the self), illustrating that rejecting divine signs is not merely an external denial but an internal corruption of the soul. The phrase 'sā'a mathalan' (bad example) serves as a warning that their self-inflicted spiritual loss becomes a cautionary tale for future generations, linking cognitive denial with practical self-harm.
